info.title: Healthy Eating API
info.description:
REST API of a self-hosted Healthy Eating server, used by the iOS app.

Authenticate with an access token from the server's OAuth 2.1 flow. Errors use one format:
`{"code", "message", "details"}`. Dates are the user's local days (YYYY-MM-DD); times are
ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Energy is in kcal, macronutrients and portions in grams.

post.description:
Add weigh-ins: one typed in the app, or a batch from Apple Health.

A weigh-in typed in the app turns weight tracking on. Apple Health entries are refused
while it is off, so imports only start after the user turns it on. All entries of one
request must have the same source.

reason.description: Why there is no estimate: fewer than 14 counted days, or weigh-ins on fewer than 6 days or spanning fewer than 14 days

arrival_status.title: Arrival Status
arrival_status.description: Whether meals still reach Healthy Eating as usual: 'ok'; 'quiet' when nothing arrived yesterday, or today although the usual time has passed (the integration may be broken); 'unknown' for new users and irregular patterns. About the integration, never about how much the user eats or logs

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: 'future': not yet; 'in_progress': today, not marked complete; 'not_logged': no meals; 'partial': marked partial; 'not_marked_complete': only complete days count

url.description: Open in the system web sheet. The user signs in with the login to add; the browser then goes to healthyeating://link/callback with `code` (finish with completeLoginLink) or `error` (cancelled or expired)

MealUpdate.description:
Only the fields present are changed; portion_grams, fiber_g, sugar_g and sodium_mg may be
null (removes the value).

Changed nutrition values become the user's own and lose their "estimated" mark.
